body: Cut. The expansion stays (D15 — stated once on the what-is surface) but nothing narrates it anymore; "Two moves, named plainly" is now "Two moves:". Swept the same self-narration family site-wide in the craft pass — "stated plainly" (why-a-catalog), "stated honestly" (vendor-neutral), "said once and plainly" (ecosystem/reliability), "The mechanism is plain" (vendor-neutral) all cut.
